fatal_gates: No matched-budget evidence of algorithmic advantage
Prior-art claim chart and original Source Pro attachments are missing

issues.claim: The GL positive-angular-Gram bound certifies the supplied FFT kernel
issues.reason: The proof is valid for a trusted symmetric positive-weight translated-cell construction with kh<=pi, but the function checks only metadata and one self entry, not the off-diagonal construction.
issues.counterexample_or_evidence: Keep metadata and self value fixed and add a sufficiently negative Hermitian off-diagonal perturbation; the function returns the same gamma although the Gram lower bound fails. The 12 tests cover only selected FFTGreen instances.
issues.required_revision: Bind certification to a verified constructor/version and saved invariants, or compute a rounding-aware Hermitian lower bound; label the result conditional on the trusted construction.

issues.claim: The Gamma formula and Euclidean adjoint apply to the stated electromagnetic discretization
issues.reason: Time convention, passivity sign, trial/test discretization, mass whitening, identical cell measure, and exact self definition are not all formal hypotheses or result metadata.
issues.counterexample_or_evidence: Changing the time convention flips the passive-loss sign; nonuniform cells require a mass inner product and invalidate the unweighted Euclidean formula.
issues.required_revision: State and serialize all sign, inner-product, grid, quadrature, and self-term assumptions; return unavailable on mismatch.

issues.claim: The local quadratic gap checks support the implemented adaptive rank rule
issues.reason: The identity covers an unconstrained fixed quadratic minimizer, whereas the implementation uses trust radii, trial rejection, and relinearization. The implemented gradient-deficit trigger is explicitly non-certifying.
issues.counterexample_or_evidence: For H=[[1,.9],[.9,1]], g=(1,0), V=span(e1), gradient deficit is 0 but the model gap is 2.131578947 and the full step has a large e2 component.
issues.required_revision: Call gradient deficit a heuristic; record trust-region KKT residual and predicted/actual reduction, and compare against a matrix-free full step under the same local subproblem.

issues.claim: Current implemented algorithms have a numerical or cost advantage
issues.reason: Adaptive tangent improves material and held error in 7/10 cases but wins wall time and total forward+tangent RHS in only 1/10; endpoints have unmatched attempts and stopping states. Explicit current wins none of material error, held error, or wall time versus LM.
issues.counterexample_or_evidence: Median LM/adaptive wall times are 1.366/2.322 s for moderate and 1.462/3.287 s for strong; median RHS are 1008/1680 and 840/1848. Explicit-current final state relative is 0.564-0.668.
issues.required_revision: Report matched operator-budget curves, repeated seeds and uncertainty, full cost accounting, and GN/LM, single-layer, random-complement, GSVD and mature TSOM baselines.

issues.claim: Certificate coverage is practically useful for solver or port decisions
issues.reason: All 36 reconstructed cases are covered, but no operational stopping/rank decision or saved cost is demonstrated.
issues.counterexample_or_evidence: bound_rel spans 0.0129-11.16 and bound/corrected-error spans 3.65-19.44; the maximum corrected relative error is 0.874.
issues.required_revision: Predefine a decision rule and report work saved plus false accept/reject rates; keep the reconstruction provenance explicit.

issues.claim: Fixed parameter-independent noise covariance implies covariance-whitened Fisher information A^T A
issues.reason: This is exact for Gaussian location noise or score-Fisher whitening, not for arbitrary noise specified only by covariance.
issues.counterexample_or_evidence: A covariance-whitened Laplace location model has a different score Fisher; heterogeneous channels need not differ by one global constant.
issues.required_revision: Assume proper complex/realified Gaussian additive noise or define W using score Fisher; retain only the local observed-data information statement.

issues.claim: The internal-propagation second layer adds measurement information or establishes improved resolution
issues.reason: After exact state elimination B is deterministic model output, not an observation. It can alter regularization, preconditioning or nonlinear path but not observed-data Fisher information.
issues.counterexample_or_evidence: A direction can satisfy Aq=0 and have large Bq while its first-order likelihood derivative remains zero. Current results lack matched single-layer and random-complement ablations.
issues.required_revision: Remove information/resolution language; test a cost-conditioned optimization or approximation claim, and directly measure finite-amplitude data separation when asserted.

issues.reason: The local audit identifies close prior work for parameter/state adaptive certified reduction, adjoint correction, TSOM internal propagation and FFT-TSOM; searches were rate-limited and the specified 2023 TAP work was not technically compared.
issues.counterexample_or_evidence: Source Pro attachments were not retrieved; conversation bodies and reconstructed checks are not an original attachment rerun.
issues.required_revision: Retrieve original attachments, complete a claim-by-claim prior-art table, and narrow novelty to a falsifiable combined benefit supported by matched experiments.
